sources.citation: RAVEL authored premises and conventions; license: Apache-2.0. External primary references are locator-only in each registry row.

nodes.statement: Fast simulation implements the specific detector card and reconstruction model. Object efficiencies, isolation, overlap removal and working points are not universal, especially for displaced, soft or substructure-dependent objects.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

obligations.description: Bind the card and working points to sources, census each selected object and validate the response in its kinematic domain.

nodes.statement: A UFO encodes model parameters, particles, vertices and coupling orders. Successful import does not establish physical consistency, a gauge choice, intended restrictions or the normalization of a supplied coupling.
